user.title: Set Up Ultra Card Connect
user.description: Ultra Card Connect adds the Ultra Card sidebar to Home Assistant for all users on this system. Choose how you'd like to set it up.

credentials.title: Sign In to ultracard.io
credentials.description: Enter your ultracard.io account credentials. Don't have an account yet? Create one free at ultracard.io/register. Pro subscribers get their subscription synced automatically across every device.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Ultra Card Connect
reauth_confirm.description: ultracard.io no longer accepts the stored password. Enter your current ultracard.io login.

reconfigure.title: Change ultracard.io account
reconfigure.description: Enter the ultracard.io account this Home Assistant should use.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid username or password. Please check your credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to ultracard.io. Please check your internet connection and try again.
error.rate_limited: ultracard.io is limiting sign-ins from this network. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
error.bot_challenge: Can't reach Ultra Card cloud right now. Please try again in a few minutes. If this keeps happening, contact support.
